Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision

Interface VisionCameraIO

All Known Implementing Classes:
LimelightVisionCameraIO, PhotonVisionCameraIO, PhotonVisionSimCameraIO
public interface VisionCameraIO
IO layer for a single vision camera. Implementations wrap a specific vision system - LimelightVisionCameraIO for a real Limelight, PhotonVisionCameraIO for a real PhotonVision coprocessor camera, and PhotonVisionSimCameraIO for a simulated PhotonVision camera - behind a common interface so Vision can aggregate any mix of them.

  • Method Details

    • update

      VisionOutput[] update()
      Polls the camera for new results and turns them into one VisionOutput per detected pose estimate. Should be called once per robot loop (via Vision.periodic()).
      Returns:
      the pose estimate(s) produced since the last call, or an empty array if none are available (e.g. no new results, no targets, or the camera is disconnected)

    • ignoreTag

      void ignoreTag(int id)
      Excludes an AprilTag from pose estimation. Once ignored, the camera will not use this tag when computing robot pose estimates, even if it is visible.
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the apriltag to ignore

    • unIgnoreTag

      void unIgnoreTag(int id)
      Reverses ignoreTag(int), allowing a previously ignored tag to be used again.
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the apriltag to stop ignoring
